notes:
- Mid-market SaaS (product analytics + in-app help), product-led growth.
- Evaluated Hosted API first: 3-week PoC (Jan 28 - Feb 18). Quick start successful, integrated with front-end via SDK + streaming.
- PoC findings: median latency ~85ms per token (small prompt), p50 tail for multi-turn chat ~120-150ms; under load 200-350ms. Throughput requirement: sustained 25-35 QPS during peak; burst spikes to ~80 QPS for launches.
- Cost sensitivity: high. Want unit economics visibility. Explicit ask: show cost vs token mix, and optimizations (batching, prefix cache) that reduce cost by >=25%.
- Primary use: hosted real-time chat assistant for customers + nightly reranking/embeddings for search.
- Model preferences: open models ok if quality matches; prefers Redwood to manage model variants and fallbacks.
- Security: must have SSO (SAML), SOC2 compliance evidence, audit logs for tokens, KMS integration for envelope encryption. "data residency" in NA required for PII flows.
- Quote from CTO on 2026-02-18 call: "We need predictable monthly cost and guaranteed tail latency under 100ms for chat — otherwise users complain."
- After PoC they asked to see Dedicated options for predictable throughput and isolation. Started pricing conversations Feb 25.
- Negotiation focal points: commit level (tokens / GPU-hours), burst headroom (2x vs 3x), overage pricing (discounted slab vs flat), ramp schedule (3-mo ramp vs immediate commit), breakage/exit fees.
- AE notes: pushed two committed buckets: 1) conservative 150k token/month commit + 2x burst pool, 2) aggressive 300k token/month commit with lower per-token rate. Finance prefers option 2 if ramp schedule accepted.
- Legal: wants limits on surprise overages and SLA credits for latency breaches.
- Integration notes: engineering will need an SSO test tenant and access to a staging Dedicated cluster for final validation.
- "POC success — but need predictable ops" — Product lead.
